topic: How Fast Can an Arcade Machine Pay for Itself in a Bar or Event Venue?
brief_alignment: weak fit — product should appear minimally or not at all. This topic is fundamentally a B2B commercial-investment analysis (foot traffic, revenue split, coin-drop, payback period) built around coin/bill-operated deployment. ECHO Home is explicitly a residential, Free Play unit with no bill acceptor or coin acceptor and is not the product suited to this use case — that functionality belongs to ECHO Commercial, which per claims_constraints.md must not appear on B2C-facing content. The persona connection here is real but secondary: Mark and Linda's numbers-first skepticism toward hype is a useful tone parallel, not a reason to force ECHO Home into a bar-ROI narrative.
